identity.name: The Black Sea Approach
identity.concept: A storm-shrouded carrier strike against fortified coastal defenses

scene_extras.name: Storm Front
scene_extras.description: Heavy weather grounds anything not already airborne. Step up the difficulty of any Notice or Operate roll.

scene_extras.name: Coastal AAA Battery
scene_extras.description: Radar-guided. Will spend its first action acquiring lock; subsequent actions fire.

scene_extras.name: Ammunition Supply
scene_extras.description: Limited munitions for sustained engagement. Spends down across the scene.

notes: If the Doom Pool reaches d12+d12, the GM may end the scene. Storm Front escalates if the fight runs long.
